description: Plans, researches and drafts one long guide (3,000 to 5,000 words) for an X Article, a LinkedIn article, a blog or a newsletter, with a point a reader could repeat, named and dated sources, a proven structure from the size of the gap to "start this week", copyable prompts or steps, an honest "what breaks", and optional images. Use when you want a long-form piece, a playbook, a masterplan or a definitive guide that becomes the go-to resource on a topic.
